quotes: The Disabled And Here collection is published under Creative Commons attribution licensing, which means you can use, share, and adapt the images for free with appropriate credit.
Photographs can simply credit Disabled And Here. When possible, please link back to the Disabled And Here project page.
Attributions ideally follow the image. For digital use, that might mean a social media caption / thread, website footer, or end credits section.

All photographed participants have signed a model release form and granted permission for image use in any media for all purposes under Creative Commons attribution, so long as that purpose is not pornographic or defamatory.
We ask that you be thoughtful in how you put Disabled And Here's images to use.
disabled_and_here.obligations: Credit 'Disabled And Here' with a link, link the licence, note changes (CC BY 4.0 s.3(a)(1)(B)). Done in src/components/examples/Showcase.astro under the carousel ('Photos of the example creators: Disabled And Here, CC BY 4.0, cropped.'), on /brands and /creators, every page that shows these photos (Sarah's avatar also appears in Window.astro, Waitlist.astro, creators/Credit.astro and creators/Hub.astro, all on those two pages). CC BY itself does not license publicity rights (s.2(b)(1)); the signed releases DAH states cover that. Ask DAH to confirm in writing (hi@affecttheverb.com) and consider a donation, which they ask of organisations.
disabled_and_here.limits: About 200 photos from a disability-led BIPOC collection; few same-person series fit a creator persona; many subjects are masked. Not suitable for posts that must show a specific action (a skincare routine, holding a gadget).

adobe_stock_free.verdict: allowed, not usable without a login: stock.adobe.com answers scripts with a bot check, and the FAQ requires an Adobe ID to download ('If you don't have an Adobe ID, please follow the process to create one and then click the blue button'). No free assets are reachable without signing in.
quotes: Free assets meet the same standards as the Adobe Stock paid collection (including model- and property-release requirements) and are downloaded with a commercial license. (helpx.adobe.com/stock/contributor/help/free-collection-contributor-information.html)

When you download a free collection asset by clicking the blue button, you receive a royalty-free commercial-use license for that asset. ... Photos, vectors, and illustrations: Standard license (helpx.adobe.com/stock/faq.html)
If you don't have an Adobe ID, please follow the process to create one and then click the blue button to download your free asset. (same FAQ)

Under a Standard License, we grant you a non-exclusive, perpetual, worldwide ... license to use, reproduce, archive, modify, and display the Work, in all media, for (1) advertising, marketing, promotional and decoration purposes (Stock Additional Terms 3.1(A))

You must not ... (E) use the Stock Assets in a manner, or in connection with a subject, that a reasonable person could consider unflattering, immoral, offensive, obscene, or controversial ... examples of which could include ads for tobacco; adult entertainment clubs ...; implied or stated endorsements of political parties ...; or implying mental or physical impairment (7.1(E))
Editorial Works ... you must not (1) use these Editorial Works for any commercial (e.g., promotional, endorsement, advertorial or merchandising) purpose (7.2(B))
Stock Assets licensed through a Pro Edition Plan are Indemnified Stock Assets even if labeled as 'free.' Otherwise, free assets are not Indemnified Stock Assets. (1.11)
adobe_stock_free.how: Sign in at stock.adobe.com with a free Adobe ID, Free tab, Photos, People; turn off generative AI content (the free collection includes AI images: 'generative AI images that meet Adobe Stock's submission guidelines can be found in the Adobe Stock collection'); skip anything marked Editorial; open the contributor's portfolio to find 2 or 3 frames of the same model; License (free). Save the licence history page as PDF next to this file.

quotes: Unless otherwise indicated, authorization to use Magnific Content is free of charge and conditioned upon any use by the User being duly attributed to the Website/Company and, where applicable, to the Collaborator
The Magnific Content is not used in a manner that suggests an association or endorsement of any kind by the Company or the Website

freepik_magnific_free.caveat: Freepik (now Magnific) asks contributors for releases but the free licence doesn't state them per image; much of the people library is AI-generated (owner rule: no AI people). Attribution required on the page.

kaboompics.verdict: not allowed as is; possible with written consent

The photos may not be used in a way that is misleading, defamatory, unlawful, or implies personal endorsement of a product, brand, or idea without explicit consent. kaboompics.route: Email Karolina Grabowska (the only photographer) with the draft in design/content/release-template.md; proceed only with her written consent and the model's.
